title: 第十一章：龙的口水
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

这个时候苏行枫把自己戴着戒子的那只左手，伸向前方，口中并念出一段咒语。

站在那儿，慢慢的，前面的空气像扭曲出现一道两米大小的光幕，一股强大的能量从光幕中冲了出来，围绕着他和这个光幕形成一个大大的圆形屏障。

“这就是长老所说的能量吗？好像对我确实没什么影响！”

他说完这话后就试探性的把手放入光幕内，只见他的手没入进去不见了，然后他又把手抽回。

“没事，一点感觉也没有，应该没什么问题吧！”

壮着胆他就走了进去，整个身躯全没入进去了。

进去后眼前一亮，没有了那种在地下空间那种昏暗，在眼前的是一片明亮，前方到处是草地，远一点的地方是树林，再远是一片山脉，天空中一片通透，没有云。

“这光从哪来？这没有太阳啊！”

抬头向天空寻找了一下没有发现光的来源。看向前面不远处一个小水潭，他走了过去，水潭边上有一块石碑，仔细一看石碑上三个字，但是他怎么看也看不懂是什么字啊！伸手过去摸着。

‘嗡~~’

从石碑上传来一段信息：炎龙碑-炎龙空间镇守石碑，边上水潭是涎龙水，随意摄取不会干枯。

很是简单的一条信息，搞得他莫名奇妙，这还不如不说呢！这就说了一个名字是几个意思？他摸不着头脑，也只好自己走走看看这个空间，可是他才走过草地一百多米。

‘咣...哎呦！M呀！这是什么东西？’

一堵无形的屏障把他挡住，撞得他头脑昏花，伸手在那屏障那摸着，远远看去像是在跳霹雳舞呢！他摸着屏障走着，终于知道这屏障范围大小，大小以圆为雏形大概直径一百五十米大小的圆。圆内除了那个水潭和石碑外，全是草地，没有任何东西。

而屏障外却是大片的树林和山脉，现在他总算是知道，这第一阶段是什么意思了。

“看来还是要努力才行，这第一阶段才

搞不明白这里什么意思他就原路返回，这就是要出去了。

“MD可是这出去的路哪去了啊？”

这个时候他才发现，刚才那进来时的光幕不见了，跑到原来进来的地方伸手探了探，依旧没什么发现，他有些急了，这时他在心里想着戒子操作方式。

“出去”

‘嗡~’

这个时候他整个人出现在那个地下空间之中，前方已经没有了那光幕，只有一个大大的空旷的地下大厅，然而他感觉到戒子带来的异样。

“这.....炎龙空间跑到戒子中去了？这么说我以后可以带着这空间到处走了？”

正和想的是一样，戒子传来的信息当中确实是这样说的，更让他吃惊的是，这个炎龙空间本来就是戒子的一部份，现在算是回归了。戒子会自动检测佩戴者的修炼等级，然后炎龙空间就会自动

这个时候戒子还提到，炎龙空间只是戒子一个小部件，戒子还有其它一些部件，只有在佩戴者自身修为提高时会慢慢都是一些听也没听过的东西，所以他也就不管了，反正戒子会自己感应，有遇到时会提示他。

“哈哈！那是不是以后我可以在戒子里面放活人了？我要去试试先！”

他极速的就跑出这个地下大厅，跑了老长一段时间才出来，累得满头大汉，差点没用手爬上来，到最后是扶着洞壁出来的。

“MD这通道太长了，这是要在地下几千米了吧！早知道让长老等着我好了，虽说被提着像只鸡一样，但是也不至于累死我啊！”

这累的真的快像一只哈趴狗一样了，一出来他就躺在那大口大口的喘着气，这休息了快二十分钟后才坐了起来，他从戒子中取出一个杯子，然后在炎龙空间中把那涎龙水弄了点进去喝着。

“嗯！好喝，还真是好东西啊！全身都来劲了，好爽啊！再来点。”

就这么得他喝了三大杯了，喝完后发现他的精神更好了，没有了之前那疲惫的感觉，一个不小心还让他发现，这水还可以促生长，因为自己喝的时候把水洒出来了点，这个时候地上的草没一会就长高了很多，这个发现让他欣喜不已。

“回去问问长老这是什么好东西”

在这坐了一会后他把越野车拿出来，开着车就回部落里。在回去的过程中，他还不忘自己的实验，那就是试试炎龙空间能不能放活物，最终的结果是可以的，而且他还发现，自己可以不进入空间中可以感知到空间，并可以随意控制，以自己灵魂状态存在于空间之中。

他抓了一只小甲虫，放进去试了一下，小甲虫进去后飞到水潭喝着那水，可是让他吃惊的是，小甲虫一会就变大了很多，他在空间中给那水潭和石碑加上了无形屏障，这样别的动物什么的就进不去那地方了，他是怕要是以后放进了大一些的动物，不小心把石碑搞坏了就玩完了。

边研究这空间边开着车，玩的不亦乐乎，他还弄了许多虫子在里面玩，这不是他不弄大的动物，而是他现在没办法去抓啊！

“赵长老！！”

“哎！....在哪呢？”

“下面，你下来先”

“大人”

这会儿这周围都没人，这也没手机什么的，也不知道强子他们去哪了，自己也上不去那么高的房子啊！这不是叫着长老把自己带上去嘛！他这差点没骂娘了啊！

“大人，这是涎龙水啊！这可是好东西啊！”

“你知道这东西？”

Page (1/3)

At this time, Su Xingfeng stretched his left hand with the ring forward and recited a spell.

Standing there, slowly, the air in front of him twisted like a two-meter light curtain, and a powerful energy rushed out from the light curtain, forming a large circular barrier around him and the light curtain.

"Is this the energy the elders are talking about? It really doesn't seem to have any effect on me!"

After he said this, he tentatively put his hand into the light curtain. His hand disappeared inside, and then he withdrew his hand again.

"It's okay, I don't feel anything at all, it should be fine!"

Taking courage, he walked in and his whole body was submerged.

After entering, my eyes lit up. There was no longer the dimness in the underground space. What was in front of me was bright. There were grasslands everywhere in front, woods a little further away, and mountains even further away. The sky was clear and cloudless.

"Where does this light come from? There is no sun here!"

He looked up to the sky and searched for the source of the light but could not find it.Looking at a small pool not far ahead, he walked over. There was a stone tablet beside the pool. He looked carefully at the three words on the stone tablet, but he couldn't understand what the words were!Reach out and touch.

‘Buzz~~’

A piece of information came from the stone tablet: Yanlong tablet - Yanlong space guards the stone tablet. The pool next to it is filled with salivary dragon water. If you drink it at will, it will not dry up.

It was a very simple piece of information that made him wonder, so he might as well not have said it!So what does a name mean?He couldn't figure it out, so he had to walk around and look at the space by himself, but he had only walked more than a hundred meters across the grass.

‘Boom... Ouch!M!What is this?’

An invisible barrier blocked him, making him dizzy. He reached out and touched the barrier. From a distance, it looked like he was break dancing!He felt the barrier as he walked, and finally knew the size of the barrier. The size was based on a circle, which was about one hundred and fifty meters in diameter.Except for the water pool and the stone monument, the circle is completely grassy and there is nothing.

But outside the barrier are large forests and mountains. Now he finally knows what this first stage means.

"It seems that we still have to work hard. This first stage is

Not understanding what it meant, he went back the way he came, and was about to go out.

"MD, where is the way out?"

Only then did he realize that the light curtain he had entered when he came in was gone. He ran to the place where he came in and stretched out his hand to explore, but still found nothing. He was a little anxious. At this time, he was thinking about how to operate the ring.

"get out"

‘Buzz~’

At this time, he appeared in the underground space. There was no light curtain in front of him, and there was only a large, empty underground hall. However, he felt something strange about the ring.

"This... Yanlong Space ran into the ring?So I can take this space with me everywhere in the future?"

Just as he thought, the message from Jiezi did say so. What surprised him even more was that this Yanlong space was originally a part of Jiezi, and now it has returned.The ring will automatically detect the wearer's cultivation level, and then the Yanlong Space will automatically

At this time, Jiezi also mentioned that Yanlong Space is just a small part of the ring, and there are other parts of the ring. Only when the wearer's own cultivation improves, will they gradually become things that he has never heard of before, so he just ignored it. Anyway, the ring will sense it on its own and will remind him when he encounters it.

"Haha!Does that mean I can put living people in the ring in the future?I'm going to try it first!"

He ran out of the underground hall as fast as he could. He ran for a long time before he came out. He was so tired that he almost climbed up without using his hands. In the end, he came out holding on to the cave wall.

“The MD passage is too long, it must be several thousand meters underground!If I had known, I would have asked the elders to wait for me. Even though I was being carried like a chicken, I wouldn't be exhausted!"

He was so tired that he almost looked like a pampered dog. As soon as he came out, he lay there panting heavily. After resting for almost twenty minutes, he sat up. He took out a cup from the ring, and then drank some of the saliva in the Yanlong space.

"Hmm!It tastes good, it’s really good stuff!My whole body is full of energy, it feels so good!More."

So he drank three large glasses. After drinking it, he found that he was in better spirits and no longer felt as tired as before. He accidentally discovered that this water can also promote growth, because he spilled some water when he drank it. At this time, the grass on the ground grew a lot taller in a short while. This discovery made him extremely happy.

"Go back and ask the elders what a good thing this is."

After sitting here for a while, he took out the off-road vehicle and drove back to the tribe.In the process of going back, he did not forget his own experiment, which was to try whether the Yanlong space could hold living creatures. The final result was that it was possible, and he also discovered that he could sense the space without entering the space, and could control it at will, existing in the space with his own soul state.

He caught a small beetle and put it in for a try. After the small beetle went in, it flew to the pool and drank the water. But to his surprise, the beetle became much larger in a short time. He added an invisible barrier to the pool and the stone monument in the space so that other animals could not enter that place. He was afraid that if a larger animal was put in in the future, the stone tablet would be damaged accidentally and the game would be over.

While studying this space, he drove the car and had a great time. He also got a lot of bugs to play with in it. It's not that he doesn't get big animals, it's just that he can't catch them now!

"Elder Zhao!!"

"Why!....Where is it?"

"Down below, you come down first"

"My lord"

There is no one around here, there are no mobile phones or anything, I don’t know where Qiangzi and the others have gone, and I can’t go up to such a high house!Isn’t this asking the elders to take him up?He almost stopped scolding his mother!

"Sir, this is drool!This is good stuff!"

"You know this stuff?"
